mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.0% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2.0% in prior month and 5-day forward returns negative in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annually) signals delayed monetary easing, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annually and 60-day forward returns positive in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in prior month but S&P 500 returns positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals tight labor market conditions, preceding wage inflation and monetary tightening that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days in late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.5% in prior month and late-cycle expansion but 5-day returns positive in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 105.0 in prior month and 60-day returns negative in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, preceding economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0% in prior month and 20-day returns positive in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicate active monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise in prior month but S&P 500 returns positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime (RSAFS > 500000), a housing starts decline (HOUST < prior month by > 0.5%) signals sector weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 0.5% and RSAFS > 500000 but S&P 500 returns positive in > 40% of cases.
